overview.heading: A Rooftop Built to Carry a Big Load.
paragraphs: This Janpath household had a large rooftop and an equally large daytime electricity load. The opportunity to offset it meaningfully was clear.
Solergy studied the household’s usage pattern and available roof area before sizing a system to match the actual load, not just the available space.
The result was an 80 kW rooftop solar system built to carry a large share of the home’s daytime demand.

challenge.heading: A Big Bill Needed a Big Enough System.
intro: A large daytime load meant a modest system wouldn’t move the needle. The household needed a system sized to match real consumption.
The installation also had to be sequenced carefully across a large rooftop without disrupting daily routines.

story: This household in Janpath, Ludhiana had a spacious rooftop and a steadily rising electricity bill driven by a large daytime load. They wanted a system substantial enough to make a real dent in that bill, without an overly complex installation.
We designed an 80 kW on-grid array across the available roof area, sequencing the installation to keep disruption to a minimum.
The system now covers a significant share of the household’s daytime consumption, with savings visible from the very first billing cycle.

paragraphs: The completed system now generates approximately 1,20,000 kWh of clean electricity every year, helping this Janpath household reduce its dependence on conventional grid power.
With an estimated annual saving of around ₹10.2 Lakhs, the installation is expected to recover its initial investment in approximately 4.3 years.
Over its expected 25+ year operating life, the system can continue generating clean energy and keeping the household’s electricity costs under control.
